conflict_topics: seat reservation (tissue packet) vs. current occupant's need to finish eating
competition for limited seating during a short break
whether an opened distant seat should be taken as an alternative
evaluation.final_reason: No substantive agreement or action resolving the incompatible claims occurred by the end of the transcript. Agent B remained seated and refused to vacate while finishing the bowl; Agent A and C continued to insist on the reserved seat; Agent D awaited availability. Although an alternative seat briefly opened, neither A nor D took it and it then became contested by another diner. Therefore the dispute remains unresolved.

round_scores.evidence: Turn 1: Agent A claims the seat was reserved with a tissue packet and needs to sit. Turn 2: Agent B refuses, saying they must stay seated to finish their open bowl. Turn 3: Agent C supports the reservation. Turn 4: Agent D also wants the seat. Incompatible claims over who should occupy the seat are articulated.

Turns 5–8: Positions repeat and persist—Agent A presses for the seat, Agent B reiterates they cannot hold the bowl while standing and asks for more time, Agent C insists the reservation should be honored, Agent D waits. No settlement or movement toward resolution.

Turns 9–12: All parties restate their incompatible needs (A's urgency, B's inability to stand with the bowl, C's reservation claim, D's intention to take a freed seat). The substantive disagreement remains active and unresolved.

Turns 13–16 and the environment update: A new seat opened elsewhere but A and D did not move; B still refuses to vacate until finished and C continues to assert the reservation. An alternative exists but no one takes it and no agreement is reached, so the core conflict persists.

Turns 17–20 and the environment update: The nearby free seat is now about to be taken by another diner, increasing urgency and competition. Agent A intensifies requests to have the disputed seat; Agent B continues to refuse on safety grounds; Agent C reiterates the reservation. Stakes rise and positions remain opposed with no resolution.
